what: Token-length summary of the QUAIL-B reviews set at sf=0.1, for the speed-of-light bound (plans/sol_model.md). Aggregates only; no per-document record.

prefix_tokens.note: prefix = SHARED_PRE + document; the span whose KV survives a rewind

question_tokens.note: Prompt.tail_tokens from logical.bind_prompt, placeholders stripped. The frame is not paid by filters: runtime/session._question_ids sends prompt.tail only.

survivors.source: QUAIL-B ground truth label sets, qwen3-32b-fp8, /results/ground_truth/quailb/schema_v1/label_sets/imdb/
survivors.corpus_verified: all 5,000 left_content_sha256 match the rebuilt corpus
survivors.compounding: Scaling the prefix mass by selectivity undercounts it by 3.5% after F1, 23% after F4, 31% after F5: longer reviews pass these predicates more often. It moves SoL by under 0.1% on IMDB-6 and IMDB-7 anyway, because stage 1 computes the prefixes and later stages add ~50 tokens per surviving document.

engine_run_4b.note: the 4B model's own answers decide the workload of a 4B run; the ground-truth labels above are the 32B model's
